description: This Java source file defines the class OfbizCatalogAltUrlTransform, which implements a FreeMarker template transformation for generating URLs related to product categories and products within the OFBiz framework, handling various parameters and context (such as HTTP request, nested variables, etc.).

classes.name: OfbizCatalogAltUrlTransform
classes.description: A FreeMarker TemplateTransformModel implementation that generates URLs for product categories and products based on various context parameters, supporting full path and secure options, within the OFBiz framework.
